verdict.rationale: v0 states that users can fine-tune apps with visual controls and a live preview (v0-docs-7). It also documents preview deployments built from working branches, so changes can be previewed before publishing through pull requests (v0-docs-38, v0-docs-39). missing for 10: in-depth docs on interacting with the in-editor preview (clicking through flows, testing functionality), independent or hands-on corroboration of the live preview experience.
